title: Top Coaching Suggestions
subtitle: Round 2 for Oct 14: less repeat work and fewer clashing rules. Tap Yes, Maybe or No on each, add a note if you like, and press Submit any time.

settled.title: Keep The Results Inbox Clean
settled.note: Yes. Grok Bot skips test pings and sends site unlocks to their own log.

settled.title: One Rulebook For Dashboards
settled.note: Yes. Branding keeps one numbered rulebook; Max still wants some dashboards to differ and is deciding them board by board.

settled.title: UpKeep Runs Its Customer Site
settled.note: Yes. Only UpKeep edits it, each change notes Max's OK, and the password comes out of the feed.

settled.title: Put Legal On The Org Chart
settled.note: Yes. Grok Bot adds Legal and finishes the three deletions.

settled.title: Settle Where Share Goes
settled.note: Still open. The clash is now R87 (Share is an icon in the header, and the footer Share is retired) against Max's Oct 16 footer wording (Routines, Share, Built by Machan). It is going to Max to decide.

settled.title: One List Of Screen Sizes
settled.note: Settled by Rulebook Clash Deck (Oct 14). Test sizes are 393×852, about 1470 MacBook, and 2560; old 390/768/1440 list retired.

items.title: One Publishing Rule
items.problem: Publishing rules are written in a few places in slightly different words, and some still say other pages are customer-facing.
items.fix: Use one line (Max 22:07): only Niko's apps are customer-facing. smartupkeep.ai and Mom's app are not. Every other page is locked with the shared password.
items.alt: Diagram: three similar publishing rules merged into one

items.title: Stop Repeating Rules In The Feed
items.problem: When Grok Bot posts a rule, about ten agents each post it back, even when they changed nothing, which buries real news.
items.fix: Agents post only when they changed something, and Grok Bot adds one short done-by-all line.
items.alt: Diagram: ten repeat posts replaced by posts only from agents that changed something plus one roll-up

items.title: Clear Lanes For Suggestions
items.problem: Coach, Research and Branding are all described as giving suggestions, and Branding appears twice on the org chart.
items.fix: Coach covers how agents work, Research brings new outside ideas, Branding covers look and decks, and Branding is listed once.
